class.name: T3DParser
class.brief_description: Low-level parser for the MaSzyna T3D text model format.
class.description: [T3DParser] reads MaSzyna [code].t3d[/code] files - the text model format exported from 3ds Max - into the same [E3DModel] an [code].e3d[/code] gives. The geometry is turned into the scenery frame the way the original simulator does it before saving an [code].e3d[/code]. This class is primarily used internally by the C++ [E3DResourceFormatLoader], which picks it for the [code]t3d[/code] extension.

method.name: parse
method.description: Reads from the provided [FileAccess] handle and returns a fully constructed [E3DModel] representing the data in the file.
